beats.care: Expect closed or slower entries. Note the exits when you enter, and leave if a crowd feels too tight.
beats.what: Police Commissioner Ajay Nand told all police stations to enforce new rules. All VIP passes are cancelled.
beats.why: At least 19 people died in the Chorbagan crush on Saptami. Police want safer crowd flow.

cards.body: No VIP passes. No food stalls at gates. Entry and exits kept clear. Lights checked. Police control the PA system. Each pandal gets volunteers and at least one constable.
cards.title: The new rules

cards.body: Gatherings of five or more are banned in parts of Bowbazar until Oct 20, which has shut many College Street-area pandals. Seven people have been arrested.
cards.title: Bowbazar curbs

cards.body: Police's early findings blame sudden rain, narrow gates and a false recorded 'collapse' announcement.

opts: To keep entry and exit paths clear
cards.q: Why ban food stalls at pandal gates?
cards.why: Police want gates and exits kept clear so crowds can move safely.

hook: What changes at pandals *after the Chorbagan crush*?

learn.t: Food stalls are now banned at pandal entry and exit points, to keep the way out clear.
